title: Reminder frontmatter
description: YAML frontmatter for a reminder file (<id>.md) under a list folder. Mirror of SPEC.md §6.

id.description: 26-char Crockford-base32 ULID. Sortable by creation time. Filename matches.

type.description: Reserved for future entity types (note, journal_entry, ...). Reminders are 'reminder'.

list_id.description: ULID of the list this reminder belongs to.

parent_id.description: Non-null = sub-reminder. Must point at a top-level reminder; one level deep enforced.

title.description: Single-line, required. Empty string is invalid.

created.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp; never modified after creation.

modified.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp; updated on every mutation.

date.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD). The reminder's due/scheduled day.

time.description: Wall-clock local time (HH:MM:SS). Null = date-only. MUST be quoted in YAML.

time_zone.description: IANA time-zone identifier (e.g. 'America/New_York'). When non-null, the reminder fires at the given wall-clock time IN THIS ZONE — i.e., it's a fixed-zone reminder. When null, the time floats with the device. Only meaningful when time != null.

urgent.description: AlarmKit-equivalent break-through-Focus mode. Requires has_time = true (i.e., time != null).

location_trigger.description: Geofence trigger. Null = no location trigger.

completed.description: For habits, reflects current expected occurrence — see SPEC §12.

completed_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp. Set when completed flips to true.

completion_history.description: Habits only — list of dates the habit was completed. Empty for non-habits.

section.description: Shopping items only. Bundled lexicon picks if the user doesn't override.

position.description: Fractional index for manual ordering within a list.

deleted_at.description: Soft-delete tombstone. Null = live. File stays on disk.

lamport.description: Monotonic per-device counter; bumped on every mutation. Used by the future sync layer.
